primaryAlternative.title: Stock Assessment of Lake Taal and Pansipit River (DA-NFRDI Annual Report 2019)
primaryAlternative.retrievalMethod: Ordinary unauthenticated HTTPS GET; no access-control bypass.
primaryAlternative.scopeReview: Historical landed-catch assessment summary for Pansipit River. The reviewed report page supplies aggregate counts and one dominant-catch name, but no complete species list, per-species table, station coordinates, named reach, or exact capture dates.

printedStatements: This is an open access article distributed under the CC BY-NC license.
rightsReview.decision: Keep source-derived names and tabular data out of a public projection pending clarification of the license version, scope, and reuse terms.

primaryAlternative.decision: Retain as a cited historical aggregate lead; do not treat as a river-wide census or current-presence baseline.

relatedSourceChecks.observedAccessResult: The official repository download URL returned an NFRDI login page; no full report or species table was acquired.
relatedSourceChecks.decision: Keep indexed summary as a lead only; do not infer or publish a complete species list.

repositoryMetadataFacts.fieldPeriod: 2011 wet and dry seasons; July and January

relatedSourceChecks.observedAccessResult: The UPLB repository record says a digital copy exists and links to a third-party author copy; ordinary requests to the official JESAM article and PDF returned HTTP 403.
relatedSourceChecks.decision: Metadata-only historical survey lead; no per-species table or species assertions admitted.

comparabilityLimits: The 2016, 2019 and 2023 sources use different years, designs and sampling scopes; their totals are not a trend series.
The 2019 report's 42 organisms comprise 36 finfishes, two molluscs and four crustaceans; they must not be represented as 42 fish species.
Landed catches do not establish all species present in the river, current abundance, catchability, legality, safety or habitat geometry.
